system.description:
You charge energy, preparing a Focused Attack. It becomes a Trigger Action with the Trigger, "You decide to make an Attack." You must use this attack before the start of the next Player Phase. While Annihilate is a Trigger Action, Destruction abilities have their Stamina cost reduced by 2.

This attacks base damage is equal to [Soul] x the amount of Abilities used during its charging. Annihilate counts as an ability used for this feature.
